title: Null-byte check needs security context comment
description: Line 216-218 validates that user_profile.id contains no null bytes, but the check lacks a comment explaining why (prevents injection in downstream string handling, logging, or path operations). A new contributor seeing this might think it's defensive over-engineering or might not understand when to apply the same pattern elsewhere in the codebase. Suggest adding: '// Null bytes could break downstream string handling or path operations — reject early.'
